<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will compare the observed chemical shift values to typical aromatic carbon shift ranges (≈120–150 ppm) using the retrieve_carbon_shifts reference. By counting how many signals fall within the aromatic range, I can infer the number of aromatic carbons.</thought>
